user.title: Pair with eSMART
user.description: On the eSMART wall unit, open **Settings → Remote access** and start adding a new remote so a pairing code is shown. Enter that code below. The wall unit has to accept it within about 45 seconds.

reauth_confirm.title: Pair with eSMART again
reauth_confirm.description: The wall unit no longer accepts this remote, for example because it was deleted there. On the eSMART wall unit, open **Settings → Remote access** and start adding a new remote so a pairing code is shown. Enter that code below. The wall unit has to accept it within about 45 seconds.

data_description.pairing_code: The number the wall unit shows while adding a remote.

reconfigure.title: Pair with eSMART again
reconfigure.description: This registers a new remote and replaces the current one, keeping your entities. On the eSMART wall unit, open **Settings → Remote access** and start adding a new remote so a pairing code is shown. Enter that code below. The wall unit has to accept it within about 45 seconds.

room_access_denied.title: eSMART wall unit denies access
room_access_denied.description:
The wall unit doesn't let {title} into its device room, so no devices or updates arrive. This usually means the remote was deleted on the wall unit or pairing didn't finish.

To fix it, go to **Settings → Devices & services → eSMART**, open the menu of the entry and choose **Reconfigure** to pair again.
